# v0.6.0 — Explanations and dependency-first adapters

## Highlights

- **`ontologos-explain`**: proof graphs from RDFS, RL, and EL routes (traces empty until whelk/reasonable expose rule diagnostics)
- **`ontologos-bridge`**: shared adapters between core, horned-owl, whelk, and reasonable
- **EL → whelk**, **RL/RDFS → reasonable**: custom in-tree rule engines removed; public facade APIs unchanged
- **CLI**: `ontologos explain --profile auto|el|rl|rdfs`
- **CI gates**: Pizza EL golden vs whelk; Family RL triple closure vs reasonable

## Published crates

- `ontologos-bridge` 0.6.0 (new)
- `ontologos-explain` 0.6.0 (new)
- All other library crates bumped to **0.6.0**

## Upgrade notes

See [docs/migration/v0.5.x-to-v0.6.0.md](../../docs/migration/v0.5.x-to-v0.6.0.md).

Key changes:

- `MaterializationReport.traces` → `.trace`
- `inferred_by_rule` counts are empty under the reasonable adapter until upstream adds rule diagnostics
- EL `classify()` returns a `Taxonomy`; RL/RDFS `materialize()` / `saturate()` merge into the ontology
